title: save_dependency input
description: Records that an application depends on another application or on a component, changes that dependency, or ends it (O04), as reported. One open dependency per application, target and dependency type: a save for a pair already linked changes that link. endedOn ends it, and an ended dependency never changes again. The owner of the depending application, an architect or the platform admin writes it.

dependencyId.description: The dependency to change or end. Leave it out to record a new one.

toApplicationId.description: The application depended on. Give this or technicalComponentId.

dependencyTypeKey.description: The kind of dependency, such as reads-data-from. Required for a new one.

criticalityKey.description: How badly the dependant is hit if the target fails, from the criticality list.

endedOn.description: Ends the dependency on this date.
